subject: Avicenna Security
body:
Hello,

I would like to purchase Avicenna for use in a research study (I have used Avicenna previously; study IDs 3031, 3141, 3328, 3358, and 3704). However, my current institution has security concerns they need addressed.

Here's their message:
Based on the use and their storage of research data, the vendor will need to provide us with an assessment of their security controls and legal will need to review their terms and conditions to determine if any modifications are need and/or our terms and conditions need to be included. These activities occur as part of the purchasing process. While I did not note any significant issues in the review of the website and your information, there is no way to know if the vendor will provide security information or work with legal.

You can proactively reach out to your contact and ask if they will complete the HECVAT (attached) and if they would be willing to negotiate terms as we are a state agency and cannot agree to certain terms. If they are unwilling to respond to the HECVAT or negotiate, it may be difficult to move forward.

Would you be able to let me know if Avicenna would be willing to work something out with my university, so I can figure out an appropriate solution? Thank you for any help you can provide.

Best,

Clarissa

—

Clarissa Ong, Ph.D. (she/her)
Assistant Professor
Department of Psychological & Brain Sciences
University of Louisville
Email: clarissa.ong@louisville.edu
Process-Oriented Intervention Science (POIS) Lab
Schedule a meeting with me

subject: Avicenna Security
body:
Dear Clarissa,

My name is Mohammad, CEO of Avicenna, and I will be more than happy to help you with this question.

We do have a copy of HECVAT completed around 4 months ago, that I attached here. In case it can help, we also comply with the following standards:

* GDPR & HIPAA: Externally audited. Results will be available by the end of the year and can be shared upon request.
* FDA 21 CFR Part 11
* ISO/IEC 27001:2022

I'm sure this can help expedite the approval in your institution.

On a separate note, congratulations on your new position. Looking forward to seeing more exciting research from you there.

Best,
Mohammad

--
